heading: Meet the Team
intro: A small but dedicated team, we at Kelly Marie Wellbeing are passionate about delivering quality wellbeing support for businesses and workforces.

people.name: Kelly Marie
people.bio: A psychotherapist with years of clinical experience working with individuals, couples, young people and organisations. Kelly's practice is grounded in psychodynamic theory alongside integrative and trauma-informed approaches. She specialises in workplace therapy and wellbeing, and has worked with organisations including LADBible and Genuit Group.

people.name: Ella Kitching
people.bio: A psychology graduate with a passion for mental health, Ella hosts The Kelly Marie Podcast and runs our social media.
